products.name:
KS-13
Keyboard Stand
products.description:
The KS-13 is a robust keyboard stand that looks great and is simple to use. The table-style platform works with a variety of instrument types, from lightweight synthesizers to heavy 88-key stage pianos. Angled legs provide rock-solid stability with plenty of clearance underneath, and you can easily adjust the width and height for your ideal playing comfort.

The KS-13 allows you to make core stand adjustments without needing tools. Grab the quick-release lever to set the proper width for the keyboard you want to use. Then use the knobs on each leg to access three height settings to suit your situation.

When you place your instrument on the KS-13, it’s supported with four large rubber grommets that eliminate movement while playing heavy rhythms, glissandos, and dynamic solos. And with the adjustable feet, you can dial in the legs for wobble-free operation on uneven floors.

The KS-13 breaks down quickly for transportation and storage. Fold down the left/right leg pairs for carrying to the gig or stowing in a closet. Then swing them out and lock them in place when it’s time to play.

Fast Adjustment

Maximum Stability

Folding Design

products.name:
CB-V61
Keyboard Bag
products.description:
The CB-V61 bag is a versatile carrying solution for portable 61-note keyboards like GO:KEYS 3, GO:KEYS 5, JUNO-D6, and other Roland models. Whether using the comfortable carrying handles or padded backpack straps, traveling to music sessions is easy with this quality bag.

The CB-V61 protects your keyboard at home and on the move. It features a durable polyester exterior, an adjustable internal securing strap, and three removable cushions that allow you to customize the fit for your instrument’s dimensions.

With the CB-V61's large front pocket, you have a convenient home for stowing cables, AC cords, and other essential accessories. It’s also the perfect size to carry the optional music rest for the Roland GO:KEYS 3 and GO:KEYS 5 models.

Carry your keys in style and show off your favorite keyboard brands with three included key chains that feature Roland, JUNO, and GO:KEYS logos.

Customizable Protection

Large Storage Pocket

Three Key Chains

products.name:
KS-11Z
Keyboard Stand
products.description:
The feature-rich KS-11Z provides a rugged, attractive, and stable platform for 88-note stage pianos and other portable keyboards. Steel construction offers robust performance, while multiple adjustment points allow you to tailor the stand’s width and height for any home, stage, or studio setup. Assembly is fast and easy with integrated push pins and foldable padded support arms.

For over five decades, Roland has been a worldwide leader in stage pianos, synthesizers, and other keyboards for musicians from hobbyist to professional. The KS-11Z is filled with smart design details informed by our long development knowledge, delivering a premium experience for all types of instruments. Heavy-duty steel construction and a solid Z shape provide rock-solid stability in a minimal footprint, making it a great solution for supporting 88-note pianos in the RD and FP series and other heavy keyboards.

The KS-11Z is designed for precision adjustment, with a quick-release lever that enables you to set the width to any position within a wide range.

You can sometimes come across uneven surfaces on performance stages and in studio environments. The KS-11Z features adjustable feet to eliminate wobble and dial in the perfect balance for your situation.

The KS-11Z features a foldable design for transport and storage. When you’re ready to use the stand, simply unfold the padded arms and they will automatically lock in place. And when the gig’s over, press the buttons to release the pins and fold the arms back down.

Superior Roland Performance

Seamless Width Adjustment

Maximum Stability

Fast and Smooth Assembly

products.name:
CB-404
Carrying Case
products.description:
The CB-404 is the official carrying case for the Roland SP-404MKII and previous models in the iconic SP-404 portable sampler series. Streamlined and rugged, it features a semi-rigid EVA shell with a tough polyester exterior and a moveable internal partition that creates separate compartments for the sampler and items such as an AC adaptor. There’s also a detachable pouch for small items, plus a shoulder strap with a wide adjustment range. As a bonus, we’ve also included four orange knobs for customizing the look of the SP-404MKII model.

Roland SP samplers are the bona fide kings of performance-based beatmaking, celebrated for their distinctive sound and ability to create rapid-fire beats anywhere. With the CB-404, you can be sure your SP instrument is well protected no matter where you travel.

The CB-404’s semi-rigid EVA exterior provides durable protection with reduced weight. An internal partition is secured with hook-and-loop attachments, allowing you to adjust the compartment sizes for different SP-404 models and various accessories. A detachable pouch is fitted into the lid for stowing other small items and features a soft fabric material to protect the sampler’s faceplate.

The CB-404 includes a tough shoulder strap with a wide adjustment range for different traveling styles. And when you want to carry the case by hand or stow it in a larger bag, simply remove the strap with the easy-to-detach clips.

Many creators like to personalize the knobs and faceplate on the SP-404MKII to match their mood or style. The CB-404 comes with a set of four knobs in classic orange, allowing you to change up the look of your sampler in seconds.

Note: The included knob set only works with the SP-404MKII model and is not available separately.

Create with Confidence

Light and Rugged

Versatile Strap Design

Custom Knobs
